description: Transparent synthetic/demo rule catalog for organic-solvent pre-review.

rules.title: PPE evidence
rules.recommended_control: 护目镜、实验服和适配手套

rules.title: Ventilation evidence
rules.recommended_control: 通风柜或有效局部排风

rules.title: Waste stream
rules.recommended_control: 有机废液分流、容器标签和暂存责任人

rules.title: Incompatibility separation
rules.recommended_control: 相容性确认、分区存放和人工复核

rules.title: Equipment boundary
rules.recommended_control: 设备联锁、温控边界和停止条件

rules.title: Ignition source
rules.recommended_control: 移除或隔离点火源并由负责人确认

rules.title: Evidence sufficiency
rules.recommended_control: 补充可追溯原文或进入人工复核
